objective: Repair the Bominal-regression gap by adding a cohesive Oyatie Identity + Workforce suite that visibly integrates Bominal-inspired Auth, sessions, roles, organization profile, employee directory, and onboarding workflows into the dashboard rather than presenting separate mixed cards.
implemented: Added a deep Identity + Workforce suite to the dashboard immediately after the corporate operations graph, so Bominal settings/auth/org/employee/onboarding capability is a cohesive product area, not a disconnected card mix.

Added Bominal-derived settings rail, active admin identity, passkey/MFA authentication methods, security score card, session/device register, role-envelope matrix, organization profile KPIs, legal/bank/payroll/insurance detail cards, employee directory stats/search/filters/table, and workspace onboarding checklist.
Mirrored the new suite in SSR static HTML so the live Podman prototype renders it before WASM hydration and before the visual fallback takes over.

Added visual-only interactions: tab switching, command-palette jump, passkey draft row + security score update, employee search/filter, local employee invite row, onboarding progress advancement, and local status feedback.
Added Bominal-like dense flat styling using existing Oyatie/Bominal tokens: cool neutral panels, compact rail controls, tab pills, tabular metrics, low-radius tables, and Korean-first content.
Added command palette action for Identity & Workforce and hash-addressable states for auth/sessions/roles/org/employees/onboarding screenshot reproduction.

observations: Captured auth, organization profile, employee directory, onboarding, and command palette states at 1440x900.
Hash-addressed screenshots prove the identity suite can reproduce deep product states from the live SSR shell.

visual_verdict.category_match: Bominal-style enterprise settings/workforce suite embedded coherently into Oyatie's operations dashboard
visual_verdict.verdict: This slice now passes the Visual Ralph threshold for the missing Bominal auth/org/employees/onboarding feature gap. It is intentionally Oyatie-branded and integrated into the dashboard shell rather than a direct Bominal clone.
improved_matches: Auth page now has left settings rail, passkey/MFA rows, recovery methods, security score, and add-passkey interaction.
Organization profile now has KPI cards plus legal, bank/payment, payroll calendar, and social-insurance information density similar to Bominal.
Employee directory now has stats, search, filters, dense table rows, manager/team/status columns, and local add-invite behavior.
Onboarding now has a 9-step setup path, progress indicator, current step card, and local progress advancement.
The suite is cohesive within one product surface and linked from left rail plus command palette.
remaining_differences: This is still a prototype surface with local browser interactions only; it does not perform real authentication, HR writes, filings, mail sends, or workflow execution.
The live Podman SSR container still lacks the generated /pkg JS glue, so the intended fallback mounts after a known /pkg 404; visual functionality remains available through prototype-interactions.js.
Bominal's pages are separate routes; Oyatie intentionally integrates them as one in-dashboard suite for cohesive product flow.
Exact icons, type metrics, and route-specific whitespace are close but not a literal pixel clone.

non_claims: No live auth mutation, passkey creation, session revocation, or role policy change occurs.
No external HR, payroll, banking, insurance, email, messenger, community, or filing system is contacted.
No persistence is claimed beyond local DOM state in the visual prototype.
This does not complete every Bominal route; it closes the major identity/workforce/settings gap in the current mockup.
